name: omega-sentinel
description: Read-only window into your local OMEGA Market Sentinel: prices, alerts, history and system health.
long_description: Lets Claude query the OMEGA stack running on this machine (giant-core, `docker compose up`). Every tool is read-only, and the server only talks to the OMEGA relay on 127.0.0.1. It holds no API keys and cannot place orders, write to the database, or reach the internet.

omega_url.title: OMEGA relay URL
omega_url.description: Where the OMEGA dashboard runs on this machine. Must be 127.0.0.1 or localhost.

tools.name: sentinel_market_snapshot
tools.description: Latest price, 1h/24h change and 24h volume per tracked pair

tools.name: sentinel_list_alerts
tools.description: Detected price shocks, volume spikes and drawdowns, filterable

tools.name: sentinel_price_history
tools.description: Summarised price curve and stats for one pair over up to 7 days

tools.name: sentinel_system_status
tools.description: Health of relay, n8n, PostgREST and Timescale

prompts.name: market_brief
prompts.description: Short briefing on the market and the alerts that matter
prompts.text: Brief me on the last ${arguments.hours} hours using the OMEGA Sentinel tools.
